text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
âWith 100 meters to go, Hishi Akebono 
leaps into the lead! Bouncing her massive 
180cm frame, she powers up the slope with 
incredible force!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Taaahh--!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
They're desperately pursuing from behind, 
giving chase, but cannot reach— Hishi 
Akebono crosses the finish line in first 
place at full power!
(Waaaaah--!)

One day, having begun running through the 
Twinkle Series together with Hishi 
Akebono. After finishing a mock race—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
The soup has a light, clean flavor with 
kelp, light soy sauce, sake, mirin, and 
salt♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"To make up for that, the meatballs are 
well-seasoned. The secret ingredients are 
miso and sugar. A sweeter flavor profile—"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Adding water while kneading it brings out 
a whole lot of rich flavor~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"And with that, Hishi Akebono's Special 
Chanko Nabe is served☆"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Eat up, everyone~! Fill your bellies so we 
can do our best again tomorrow~!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Yaaay!

Hishi Akebono was serving chanko nabe to a 
large group of Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
That's right~. I figured after going all 
out against each other in the mock race, 
we'd all want to eat till we're stuffed, 
so I made a ton of food, but—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Looks like they're almost all gone! I'm so 
happy everyone's eating so much~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
And with that, I've gotta hurry and eat 
too! I'll bring some over for you as well, 
Trainer~.
—Hishi Akebono's dream is "chanko nabe."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"An Umamusume that they, too, can clash 
with at full power!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Someone satisfying, who can make you smile 
whether you win or lose!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"So you entered Tracen Academy because you 
wanted to become like that~."

In races, we give it our all until we're 
satisfied. In cooking, we serve plenty 
until we're satisfied.

That's the kind of person Hishi Akebono 
wants to be: an essential presence that 
helps all the sumo wrestlers grow big and 
strong together—
In other words, chankonabe.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Akebono! It was so much fun 
hanging out with everyone!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"You are excellent, but still! In the next 
race, victory will be mine!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Well, because right now... I'm just 
bursting with energy!

Taiki Shuttle, big in both body and heart, 
and the overwhelming Class Rep, Sakura 
Bakushin O. Both came over to greet me 
with satisfied looks on their faces.

Sakura Bakushin O in sprints, and Taiki 
Shuttle in sprints and miles—both are 
formidable powerhouses boasting brilliant 
track records.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, me too! I'm counting on you in our 
next race as well~♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: —Phew, that was so much fun~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
—Ehehe. You know, days like today where 
everyone is smiling and happy... I really 
love seeing that after all~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I was thinking I'd love to do a whole 
bunch of things in the Twinkle Series too~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I hope everrryone can be totally satisfied 
with the race and smile happily~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Guess I've gotta give it my all.
Just then—
(Patter-patter-patter)

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Bonobonobonobono~~!

Biko Pegasus—a hero-aspiring Umamusume and 
good friends with Hishi Akebono—came 
rushing over in a panic.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Huh, Biko-chan? What's the matter?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Look, look, the TV, the TV~~!

Urged on by a frantic Biko Pegasus, I 
returned to the Trainer's Office and 
turned on the TV—

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
"One of the biggest Umamusume since the 
founding of the Twinkle Series, Hishi 
Akebono!"

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
"Set to debut this year, she has already 
garnered massive attention due to her 
sheer impact!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Look! Bono is on TV! That's so awesome--!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ah! That's from the interview the other 
day. Ahaha, they made me look pretty cool, 
didn't they~?

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text:
"‘She’s so big and cute, I became a fan 
the moment I saw her in a magazine!’"

text_block_list.name: Man A
text_block_list.text:
"I'm really looking forward to Hishi 
Akebono's debut race!"

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
"Even now, prior to her debut, Hishi 
Akebono is already creating quite a buzz. 
We're truly looking forward to her future 
achievements!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Wah. Everyone's already looking forward to 
it~.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Aren't you surprised?! You haven't even 
debuted yet, but all eyes are on you!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha. True~ It feels kind of strange, 
maybe!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it, there were comments 
on my Umastagram post wishing me luck on 
my debut, too."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, there's this social media app called 
Umastagram where you can post photos and 
livestream~. Sometimes people do cooking 
streams and—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: And, umm, this one right here~!

Amidst all the "Looking forward to your 
debut!" and "Good luck!" comments, there 
was one that caught my eye.

"With a body that big, she probably can't 
run long distances." "She's so powerful, 
dirt would suit her better, wouldn't it?"

"If your weight is too high, it puts a 
huge strain on your legs. Are you alright? 
I'm a little worried..."
choice_data_list:
There sure are a lot of different 
opinions, huh.

There are quite a lot of different 
opinions, huh.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Indeed.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
True, since I'm on the bigger side, I'm 
not super confident in my stamina, and 
there might be more strain on my legs 
compared to lighter girls, y'know~?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
“Still. Even so, I think being big is a 
good thing~”

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
You get such a greaaat view, you can grab 
stuff, and plus, plus, being number one is 
the most fun!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
True, Bono wouldn't be Bono if she wasn't 
big~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Ahaha. That's true, isn't it~

"In that case, for the Twinkle Series, we 
should build up training that maximizes 
her physique and seize victory that way."

A few days after I started thinking about 
that...

Over a bowl of Hishi Akebono's chanko 
nabe, we sat down to discuss future plans.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Huh? We're focusing on body conditioning 
for a while~?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Hmm, I see~...

Having a larger body and more 
weight—greater mass— is often advantageous 
when reaching top speed.

In other words, Hishi Akebono's 
extraordinary size can undoubtedly become 
a one-of-a-kind weapon.
Even so, in order to make the most of it—
choice_data_list:
I need to build a tougher, more resilient 
body

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: ...A strong, sturdy body?

Take a motorcycle and a large bus, for 
instance. If both take a corner at the 
same speed, the heavier large bus will 
experience much greater centrifugal force.

The greater the mass, the stronger the 
centrifugal force, and the physical toll 
required to control it becomes just as 
massive.

Additionally, when accelerating from a 
standstill to top speed, the greater the 
weight, the more leg strength required, 
increasing the physical toll.
choice_data_list:
That's why I want to build a body that 
won't give in to the strain.

text_block_list.text:
Indeed, as I broke it down and explained 
it to her, her round eyes grew even 
rounder.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer. Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
So conditioning your body doesn't just 
mean losing weight~?
choice_data_list:
Being big is my weapon and what makes me 
unique, so I want to make the most of it!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. I see. Then I'd better work hard on 
building up my body~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"I was thinking that one felt more like 
me, too."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
You were thinking the exact same thing, 
Trainer~!

Until her body is fully developed, I want 
to prioritize training over races for a 
while.

If we want to make the most of her 
strengths, now is the time to patiently 
lay the groundwork.
choice_data_list: Let's take it slow and do things our way.
Let's go at our own pace, in our own way.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, don't you want seconds? I'll heap 
up plenty of your favorites!

A visibly cheerful Hishi Akebono served up 
a generous portion of sweet tsukune 
meatballs.

And so, my days of racing through the 
Twinkle Series alongside Hishi Akebono 
began!
